# SQLite: licenca

O SQLite esta em dominio publico (https://sqlite.org/copyright.html). O cabecalho de `sqlite3.c` e `sqlite3.h` traz a "bencao"
no lugar de uma licenca:

    The author disclaims copyright to this source code.  In place of
    a legal notice, here is a blessing:

      *   May you do good and not evil.
      *   May you find forgiveness for yourself and forgive others.
      *   May you share freely, never taking more than you give.

Identificador SPDX: `blessing`. Nao ha restricao de uso, copia, modificacao ou redistribuicao.
